Update Reconcontrol.dbo.tbl_Catalyst_T1_Allocation_Staging
set entrydate = cast(entrydate as date)

DELETE A
FROM Reconcontrol.dbo.[tbl_Catalyst_T1_Allocation_Archive] A
 JOIN Reconcontrol.dbo.[tbl_Catalyst_T1_Allocation_Archive] B
 ON A.STREETS_TICKET = B.PARENT_TICKET
 AND A.TRADEDATE = B.TRADEDATE
 AND A.SETTLEDATE = B.SETTLEDATE
WHERE (A.ALLOCATABLE = 'Y' AND A.ISALLOCATED = 'N' AND A.TRADESUBTYPE IN ( 'Parent_Trade', 'CUSTOMER_Trade')) 
 OR  (A.ALLOCATABLE = 'Y' AND A.ISALLOCATED = '' AND A.TRADESUBTYPE IN ( 'Parent_Trade', 'CUSTOMER_Trade'))
 OR  (A.ALLOCATABLE = 'Y' AND A.ISALLOCATED is NULL AND A.TRADESUBTYPE IN ( 'Parent_Trade', 'CUSTOMER_Trade'))
 AND Cast(A.loaddate as date) <  Cast(B.loaddate as date)
